en_excerpt: Chef Anderson Balico's quick Korean BBQ-style beef stir-fry: fifteen minutes to marinate, five minutes in the pan.
en_meta_description: A Korean BBQ-style beef stir-fry from Chef Anderson Balico, with soy, honey and Korean BBQ seasoning, ready in 20 minutes.
en_content:
By: Chef Anderson Balico Food Content Creator & Digital Marketing

Ingredients

400 g beef strips

2 tablespoons of ÍON Korean BBQ Organic Seasoning

2 tablespoons of soy sauce (shoyu)

1 tablespoon of honey1 tablespoon of ÍON Sunflower Oil

1 red pepper, sliced

1 onion, sliced

1 spring onion, finely chopped

Method:

Mix the beef with the soy sauce, the honey and the Korean BBQ seasoning. Leave to marinate for 15 minutes.

Heat the sunflower oil in a frying pan or wok over a high heat and stir-fry the beef for about 5 minutes, until browned.

Add the onion and the red pepper and cook for a further 3 to 4 minutes, until softened.

Finish with the spring onion and serve with rice or noodles.

translator_notes: Brand name ÍON kept; the Portuguese product descriptor was translated so English readers know what to buy (Tempero Organico Korean BBQ -> Korean BBQ Organic Seasoning, Oleo de Girassol -> Sunflower Oil). Colheres de sopa -> tablespoons, cebolinha -> spring onion (IE/UK usage).
